title: The Gran Sasso laboratory and the Gerda experiment

tellings.quote: It is called the Gerda experiment because they are they didn't find it still find it. The so-called Majorana particle.

plain: Under the Gran Sasso mountain in Italy there is a physics laboratory where an experiment called Gerda searched for the Majorana particle, a long-sought particle that would be its own antiparticle, and, as the story goes, it has still not found it. Filippo Biondi, a guest who appears on an episode about structures said to lie beneath the Egyptian pyramids, mentions this in passing, relaying what he has heard about the work there.
